paragraphs.en: Harness self-evolution revises an agent’s software scaffolding, including prompts, memory, workflows, and executable components, while keeping model weights fixed. We formalize a feedback-driven process in which accepted revisions persist across runs. The framework separates update targets from proposal and admission mechanisms. It distinguishes changes to interpreted state from revisions to tools and code, repository-level control logic, and plugin composition. We characterize search through evolutionary optimization and examine its reliability through continual PAC-learning. Under explicit assumptions, the analysis yields an expected generalization bound, a retention bound conditional on historical regression budgets, and a high-probability admission rule using fresh, independent validation data. We examine how persistent harness revisions affect knowledge sharing and organizational workflows, with implications for scientific reliability, physical safety, and institutional accountability. Cases from prior work illustrate model–harness co-design, distributed execution, and plugin reuse. Reliable deployment requires continual validation as task distributions and evaluators change, with independent safeguards for learning, runtime privileges, and consequential actions. We provide a comprehensive 66-page discussion of related work, theory, algorithms, evaluation, applications, and the broader impact of Harness RSI, together with continuously updated code and supplementary materials, at https://github.com/zgcagi/Harness-RSI.
paragraphs.zh: Harness 自我演化机制会修改智能体的软件框架，包括提示、记忆、工作流和可执行组件，同时保持模型权重不变。 我们将反馈驱动的流程形式化，其中被接受的修改会在多次运行中持续保留。 该框架将更新目标与提案及接纳机制分离开来。 它区分了对解释状态的更改与对工具、代码、仓库级控制逻辑和插件组成的修订。 我们通过演化优化来描述搜索过程，并通过持续的 PAC 学习检验其可靠性。 在明确假设下，该分析得出一个期望泛化界、一个以历史回归预算为条件的保留界，以及一个使用全新独立验证数据的高概率接纳规则。 我们研究了持久的 Harness 修订如何影响知识共享和组织工作流，这对科学可靠性、物理安全及机构问责制具有启示意义。 先前工作的案例展示了模型与 Harness 的协同设计、分布式执行和插件重用。 可靠的部署需要随着任务分布和评估者的变化而持续验证，并配备独立的安全保障机制，分别针对学习过程、运行时权限和关键操作。 我们在 https://github.com/zgcagi/Harness-RSI 上提供了关于 Harness RSI 的 66 页全面讨论，涵盖相关工作、理论、算法、评估、应用及其更广泛影响，并附有持续更新的代码和补充材料。

paragraphs.en: As tasks and environments change after deployment, agents need mechanisms for continued adaptation. Harness self-evolution uses execution feedback to revise instructions, memory, and control logic while keeping model weights fixed. Later runs load accepted revisions, and the update mechanism remains available to learn from subsequent experience (Section 2 ). This process builds on recursive self-improvement and self-referential problem solving in the context of contemporary agents ( good1965ultraintelligent ; schmidhuber2003godel ) .
paragraphs.zh: 部署后，随着任务和环境的变化，智能体需要具备持续适应的机制。 利用自演化机制会借助执行反馈来修订指令、记忆和控制逻辑，同时保持模型权重不变。 后续运行会加载已接受的修订内容，且更新机制仍可用以从后续经验中学习（第 2 节）。 这一过程建立在当代智能体中的递归自我改进和自我参照问题解决之上（good1965ultraintelligent；schmidhuber2003godel）。

paragraphs.en: Adaptation can revise model weights or the harness governing prompts, memory, workflows, and tools. Our focus on the latter rests on three considerations. First, the harness directly shapes a fixed model’s behavior, while reusable procedures preserve task constraints and lessons from earlier failures ( chan2025mlebench ; zhao2024expel ; wang2024voyager ) . Second, harness revisions reuse an existing model deployment, avoiding retraining and additional weight checkpoints. This can reduce adaptation and maintenance costs and permits updates through proprietary APIs without access to model weights. Third, instructions, memory records, and code support direct inspection, version comparison, and change tracking; attributing behavioral differences between model checkpoints can require additional controlled experiments. We hold the task model fixed to isolate harness self-evolution, with joint model–harness evolution addressed in Section .
paragraphs.zh: 适应过程可以修改模型权重，或调整控制提示词、记忆、工作流和工具的框架。 我们关注后者，主要基于三个方面的考量。 首先，该框架直接决定了固定模型的行为，而可重用的程序则能保留任务约束以及早期失败的经验教训（chan2025mlebench；zhao2024expel；wang2024voyager）。 其次，框架的修订可以复用现有的模型部署，从而避免重新训练和生成额外的权重检查点。 这能够降低适应与维护成本，并允许通过专有 API 进行更新，而无需访问模型权重。 第三，指令、记忆记录和相关代码支持直接检查、版本对比与变更追踪；而要归因于不同模型检查点之间的行为差异，则可能需要额外的受控实验。 我们将任务模型保持固定，以单独研究框架的自我演化；模型与框架的联合演化将在第 节中讨论。

paragraphs.en: Existing methods vary in what is modified, how candidates are generated, and how revisions are admitted ( shinn2023reflexion ; zhao2024expel ; wang2024voyager ; zhang2025aflow ; robeyns2025selfimproving ) . We first classify the update target : the state modified and inherited by later runs. Interpreted-state updates revise instructions, stored experience, or task-level coordination over predefined capabilities; executable revisions change capability implementations, runtime control logic, or plugin-based service composition (Section 3 ; Figure 1 ). Empirical selection alone does not establish generalization or retention. Section relates candidate search to evolutionary structures, then uses stability and concentration results to state conditions for expected generalization, bounded accumulated regressions, and high-probability admission. Persistent state also determines how revisions propagate and which consequences software recovery can address, motivating system design choices, continual validation, and independent safety controls (Sections – ).
paragraphs.zh: 现有方法在修改对象、候选项生成方式以及修订项接纳机制方面存在差异（shinn2023reflexion；zhao2024expel；wang2024voyager；zhang2025aflow；robeyns2025selfimproving）。 我们首先对更新目标进行分类：即后续运行所修改并继承的状态。 已解释状态的更新会修订指令、存储的经验或基于预定义能力的任务级协调；可执行修订则会改变能力的实现方式、运行时控制逻辑或基于插件的服务组合（第 3 节；图 1）。 仅凭经验性选择无法确立泛化能力或保留效果。 本节将候选项搜索与演化结构联系起来，随后利用稳定性与集中性结果，提出预期泛化的条件、累积退化的有界性要求以及高概率接纳的条件。 持久状态还决定了修订项的传播方式以及软件恢复能够处理哪些后果，这为系统设计方案、持续验证及独立的安全控制提供了依据（第 – 节）。

The system uses feedback from its own executions to construct or select revisions algorithmically, and retains the mechanism for further updates. Environments, automated assessors, and people may provide feedback; admission may require human approval.

sents.en: Operational feedback and update continuity.
sents.zh: 操作反馈与更新连续性。

sents.en: The system uses feedback from its own executions to construct or select revisions algorithmically, and retains the mechanism for further updates.
sents.zh: 该系统利用自身执行过程中的反馈，通过算法构建或选择修订版本，并保留用于后续更新的机制。

paragraphs.en: Persistence across runs. Accepted revisions are stored and loaded in a subsequent run, allowing experience from one interaction to influence later execution.
paragraphs.zh: 跨运行持久性。 已接受的修订会被存储并在后续运行中加载，从而让一次交互中的经验能够影响之后的执行。

sents.en: Persistence across runs.
sents.zh: 跨运行持久性。

sents.en: Accepted revisions are stored and loaded in a subsequent run, allowing experience from one interaction to influence later execution.
sents.zh: 已接受的修订会被存储并在后续运行中加载，从而让一次交互中的经验能够影响之后的执行。

paragraphs.en: These requirements concern repeatability: one observed update can demonstrate the capability if both hold. Appending logs or compacting context under fixed rules does not revise the harness; learning reusable procedures or changing memory policies can. Revising the update mechanism adds another level of recursion.
paragraphs.zh: 这些要求涉及可重复性：如果两个条件都成立，那么一次观察到的更新就能证明这种能力。 按照固定规则追加日志或压缩上下文并不会修改框架；但学习可重用的程序或更改内存策略则可能改变它。 修改更新机制会增加另一层递归。

sents.en: These requirements concern repeatability: one observed update can demonstrate the capability if both hold.
sents.zh: 这些要求涉及可重复性：如果两个条件都成立，那么一次观察到的更新就能证明这种能力。

sents.en: Appending logs or compacting context under fixed rules does not revise the harness; learning reusable procedures or changing memory policies can.

sents.en: Revising the update mechanism adds another level of recursion.
sents.zh: 修改更新机制会增加另一层递归。

paragraphs.en: Self-evolution denotes the update process; self-improvement denotes a gain established by comparison. We use harness RSI (recursive self-improvement) as the name of the research area, without assuming that each revision helps. Weight-only adaptation and scaffolds without an update mechanism fall outside this scope. When a system also trains weights, we examine its harness updates with the task model held fixed.
paragraphs.zh: 自我演化指更新过程；自我改进指通过比较确立的增益。 我们将“利用递归自我改进（RSI）”作为该研究领域的名称，但并不假设每次修订都有帮助。 仅调整权重的适应方法以及没有更新机制的脚手架不属于此范畴。 当系统同时训练权重时，我们会在保持任务模型不变的情况下，考察其利用机制的更新情况。

sents.en: Self-evolution denotes the update process; self-improvement denotes a gain established by comparison.
sents.zh: 自我演化指更新过程；自我改进指通过比较确立的增益。

sents.en: Weight-only adaptation and scaffolds without an update mechanism fall outside this scope.
sents.zh: 仅调整权重的适应方法以及没有更新机制的脚手架不属于此范畴。

sents.en: When a system also trains weights, we examine its harness updates with the task model held fixed.
sents.zh: 当系统同时训练权重时，我们会在保持任务模型不变的情况下，考察其利用机制的更新情况。

paragraphs.en: EURISKO’s heuristic revision and the Gödel Machine’s proof-governed self-rewriting established distinct antecedents of harness self-evolution ( lenat1983eurisko ; schmidhuber2003godel ) . Contemporary methods use empirical feedback to revise prompts, consolidate persistent memory, and search workflow specifications around a fixed model ( agrawal2026gepa ; fernando2024promptbreeder ; zhao2024expel ; wang2025workflow ; zhang2025aflow ) . The interpreted/executable distinction concerns the edited artifact’s role, not its programming language. Workflow revisions remain interpreted when they change task-level sequencing or routing through fixed coordination interfaces over predefined operators. This includes code that only composes those operators; revising operator implementations or the runtime mechanisms that enact coordination constitutes an executable revision, even under an unchanged executor.
paragraphs.zh: EURISKO 的启发式修订与哥德尔机器的证明驱动型自我重写，确立了利用自我演化的两种不同先例（lenat1983eurisko ; schmidhuber2003godel）。 当代方法利用经验反馈来修订提示、巩固持久记忆，并在固定模型周围搜索工作流规范（agrawal2026gepa ; fernando2024promptbreeder ; zhao2024expel ; wang2025workflow ; zhang2025aflow）。 解释型/可执行型的区分涉及被编辑产物的角色，而非其编程语言。 当工作流修订通过固定协调接口，在预定义算子上改变任务层面的顺序或路由时，它仍然属于解释型修订。 这包括仅组合这些算子的代码；而修订算子实现或执行协调的运行时机制，则构成可执行修订，即便执行器本身未发生变化。

sents.en: EURISKO’s heuristic revision and the Gödel Machine’s proof-governed self-rewriting established distinct antecedents of harness self-evolution ( lenat1983eurisko ; schmidhuber2003godel ) .
sents.zh: EURISKO 的启发式修订与哥德尔机器的证明驱动型自我重写，确立了利用自我演化的两种不同先例（lenat1983eurisko ; schmidhuber2003godel）。

sents.zh: 解释型/可执行型的区分涉及被编辑产物的角色，而非其编程语言。

sents.zh: 当工作流修订通过固定协调接口，在预定义算子上改变任务层面的顺序或路由时，它仍然属于解释型修订。

paragraphs.en: We organize executable targets into component implementations, repository-level control logic, and plugin composition. The first two describe mutation scope; the third describes how components and runtime services are bound and replaced. Plugin composition can span component implementations and repository-level logic, so a revision may belong to more than one category. Classifying the update target does not determine whether a method satisfies the feedback, continuity, and persistence requirements in Section 2 .
paragraphs.zh: 我们将可执行目标组织为组件实现、仓库级控制逻辑和插件组合。 前两项描述了变异范围；第三项描述了组件与运行时服务如何绑定和替换。 插件组合可以跨越组件实现和仓库级逻辑，因此一个修订版本可能属于多个类别。 对更新目标进行分类并不会决定某个方法是否满足第 2 节中的反馈、连续性和持久性要求。

sents.en: We organize executable targets into component implementations, repository-level control logic, and plugin composition.
sents.zh: 我们将可执行目标组织为组件实现、仓库级控制逻辑和插件组合。

sents.en: The first two describe mutation scope; the third describes how components and runtime services are bound and replaced.
sents.zh: 前两项描述了变异范围；第三项描述了组件与运行时服务如何绑定和替换。

sents.en: Plugin composition can span component implementations and repository-level logic, so a revision may belong to more than one category.
sents.zh: 插件组合可以跨越组件实现和仓库级逻辑，因此一个修订版本可能属于多个类别。

paragraphs.en: Component-level revision confines mutation to callable procedures or designated modules while keeping surrounding orchestration outside the editable surface. Where entry points and I/O contracts remain fixed, candidates replace component implementations; tool synthesis may instead extend the callable interface. Skill libraries retain executable functions for later retrieval and composition ( wang2024voyager ; yu2025polyskill ) ; patch-based architectures, including Self-Harness, HarnessCompass, and Agentic Harness Engineering, constrain trace-guided mutation to selected components ( zhang2026selfharness ; zhang2026harnesscompass ; lin2026agentic ) . Editing memory-management functions changes the harness machinery, whereas curating stored entries changes its interpreted state ( zhang2025memevolve ) . Within this boundary, candidate archives preserve alternatives for subsequent search ( luo2026harnessbank ) , while protocol perturbations test whether an evolved harness’s gain over the initial harness survives changes in assessment conditions ( zhu2026badgenius ) . Stable interfaces facilitate replacement and local checks, but changed outputs or shared state can propagate regressions beyond the edited module.
paragraphs.zh: 组件级修订将突变限制在可调用过程或指定模块内，同时保持周围的协调机制处于可编辑范围之外。 当入口点和 I/O 契约保持固定时，候选方案会替换组件实现；而工具合成则可能扩展可调用接口。 技能库保留可执行函数以便后续检索与组合（wang2024voyager；yu2025polyskill）；基于补丁的架构，包括 Self-Harness、HarnessCompass 和 Agentic Harness Engineering，则将基于轨迹的突变限制在选定的组件中（zhang2026selfharness；zhang2026harnesscompass；lin2026agentic）。 编辑内存管理函数会改变 harness 机制，而整理已存储条目则会改变其解释状态（zhang2025memevolve）。 在此边界内，候选存档保留后续搜索所需的替代方案（luo2026harnessbank），而协议扰动则用于测试演化后的 harness 相对于初始 harness 的优势是否在评估条件变化后依然成立（zhu2026badgenius）。 稳定的接口便于替换和局部检查，但输出或共享状态的变化可能导致问题蔓延到被编辑模块之外。

sents.en: Component-level revision confines mutation to callable procedures or designated modules while keeping surrounding orchestration outside the editable surface.
sents.zh: 组件级修订将突变限制在可调用过程或指定模块内，同时保持周围的协调机制处于可编辑范围之外。

sents.en: Within this boundary, candidate archives preserve alternatives for subsequent search ( luo2026harnessbank ) , while protocol perturbations test whether an evolved harness’s gain over the initial harness survives changes in assessment conditions ( zhu2026badgenius ) .
sents.zh: 在此边界内，候选存档保留后续搜索所需的替代方案（luo2026harnessbank），而协议扰动则用于测试演化后的 harness 相对于初始 harness 的优势是否在评估条件变化后依然成立（zhu2026badgenius）。

paragraphs.en: Repository-level search exposes context construction, orchestration loops, execution hooks, recovery, and termination to revision. The boundary concerns control over interactions among harness components, rather than the number of files edited. Whole-agent synthesis searches complete control programs, while repository evolution retains implementation lineages for later selection and revision ( hu2025automated ; lee2026metaharness ; robeyns2025selfimproving ; zhang2026darwin ; zhang2026darwinx ; wang2025huxley ) . Changes to shared context, scheduling, or recovery can alter the inputs and execution assumptions of otherwise unchanged components. This coupling motivates edit constraints, transfer-oriented admission, and deployment checks ( xia2026rrsi ; cai2026moss ) . Archive membership preserves a candidate for further search; adoption additionally requires promoting the selected program into the runtime used by later tasks. Extending mutation to the optimizer’s prompts, hooks, and tools makes the update mechanism itself evolvable ( wang2026verse ) . An exported program satisfies the continuing lifecycle only if its deployment retains an update mechanism.
paragraphs.zh: 仓库级搜索将上下文构建、协调循环、执行钩子、恢复和终止过程暴露于修订之中。 该边界涉及对 harness 组件间交互的控制，而非所编辑文件数量的控制。 全智能体合成搜索完整的控制程序，而仓库演化则保留实现谱系，以便后续选择和修订（hu2025automated；lee2026metaharness；robeyns2025selfimproving；zhang2026darwin；zhang2026darwinx；wang2025huxley）。 对共享上下文、调度或恢复机制的更改，可能会改变原本未变更组件的输入和执行假设。 这种耦合催生了编辑约束、以转移为导向的准入机制以及部署检查（xia2026rrsi；cai2026moss）。 加入存档可保留一个候选项以供进一步搜索；而采用该候选项则还需将所选程序提升至后续任务使用的运行时环境中。 将突变扩展至优化器的提示、钩子和工具，可使更新机制本身具备演化能力（wang2026verse）。 一个已导出的程序只有在其部署过程中保留了更新机制，才能满足持续的生命周期需求。

sents.zh: 仓库级搜索将上下文构建、协调循环、执行钩子、恢复和终止过程暴露于修订之中。

sents.zh: 该边界涉及对 harness 组件间交互的控制，而非所编辑文件数量的控制。

paragraphs.en: HarnessOpt extends the SkillOpt-Lite study from skill editing to runtime revision, improving spreadsheet previews, output checks, and recovery after tool failures ( shen2026skilloptlite ) . On SpreadsheetBench (Table 2 ), GPT-5.4-nano with HarnessOpt and skill reaches 77.58%, exceeding GPT-5.5 with SkillOpt (76.20%); across all four models, HarnessOpt with skill improves on SkillOpt-Lite by 5.69–11.39 percentage points. This crossover illustrates model–harness pairing, but does not establish superiority at matched cost.
paragraphs.zh: HarnessOpt 将 SkillOpt-Lite 研究从技能编辑扩展到了运行时修订，改进了电子表格预览、输出检查以及工具故障后的恢复能力（shen2026skilloptlite）。 在 SpreadsheetBench（表 2）中，配备 HarnessOpt 和技能的 GPT-5.4-nano 达到了 77.58%，超过了使用 SkillOpt 的 GPT-5.5（76.20%）；在所有四种模型中，配备技能的 HarnessOpt 相较于 SkillOpt-Lite 的性能提升了 5.69–11.39 个百分点。 这种交叉表现说明了模型与 harness 的搭配效果，但并未证明在成本匹配的情况下具有优越性。

paragraphs.en: Plugin architectures organize mutation through declared interfaces, dependency constraints, and lifecycle operations. The editable object may be a component implementation or a binding that determines which implementation supplies a runtime service, such as memory storage, tool dispatch, or the agent loop. Composition here therefore reaches beyond task-level routing among fixed operators. Kernel-defined substrates specify how these services are connected, mounted, and replaced ( deepseek2026harness ; shi2026programming ) ; feedback-driven systems revise typed primitives, versioned resources, or scoped modules under interface and validation constraints ( chen2026harnessx ; li2026argus ; zhang2026autogenesis ; wu2026modularrsi ) . This organization can expose both local capabilities and core runtime services while retaining explicit constraints on their composition. Everything Is a Plugin (EIP) extends it to capabilities generated, validated, and mounted during operation. Interface contracts support compatibility checks and component replacement; they do not establish behavioral isolation or safe admission. Adoption still requires validation of the composed behavior.
paragraphs.zh: 插件架构通过声明式接口、依赖约束和生命周期操作来组织突变。 可编辑对象可能是一个组件实现，也可能是一个绑定，该绑定决定了哪个实现提供运行时服务，例如内存存储、工具调度或智能体循环。 因此，此处的组合超越了固定操作符之间的任务级路由。 内核定义的子层指定了这些服务如何连接、挂载和替换（deepseek2026harness；shi2026programming）；反馈驱动的系统会在接口和验证约束下修订类型化的原始元素、版本化的资源或作用域模块（chen2026harnessx；li2026argus；zhang2026autogenesis；wu2026modularrsi）。 这种组织方式既能暴露本地能力和核心运行时服务，又能保留对其组合的显式约束。 “万物皆插件”（EIP）将其扩展至在运行期间生成、验证和挂载的能力。 接口契约支持兼容性检查和组件替换，但并未建立行为隔离或安全准入机制。 采用时仍需对组合后的行为进行验证。

sents.en: Plugin architectures organize mutation through declared interfaces, dependency constraints, and lifecycle operations.
sents.zh: 插件架构通过声明式接口、依赖约束和生命周期操作来组织突变。

sents.en: The editable object may be a component implementation or a binding that determines which implementation supplies a runtime service, such as memory storage, tool dispatch, or the agent loop.
sents.zh: 可编辑对象可能是一个组件实现，也可能是一个绑定，该绑定决定了哪个实现提供运行时服务，例如内存存储、工具调度或智能体循环。

sents.en: Composition here therefore reaches beyond task-level routing among fixed operators.
sents.zh: 因此，此处的组合超越了固定操作符之间的任务级路由。

sents.en: Kernel-defined substrates specify how these services are connected, mounted, and replaced ( deepseek2026harness ; shi2026programming ) ; feedback-driven systems revise typed primitives, versioned resources, or scoped modules under interface and validation constraints ( chen2026harnessx ; li2026argus ; zhang2026autogenesis ; wu2026modularrsi ) .
sents.zh: 内核定义的子层指定了这些服务如何连接、挂载和替换（deepseek2026harness；shi2026programming）；反馈驱动的系统会在接口和验证约束下修订类型化的原始元素、版本化的资源或作用域模块（chen2026harnessx；li2026argus；zhang2026autogenesis；wu2026modularrsi）。

sents.en: This organization can expose both local capabilities and core runtime services while retaining explicit constraints on their composition.
sents.zh: 这种组织方式既能暴露本地能力和核心运行时服务，又能保留对其组合的显式约束。

sents.en: Everything Is a Plugin (EIP) extends it to capabilities generated, validated, and mounted during operation.
sents.zh: “万物皆插件”（EIP）将其扩展至在运行期间生成、验证和挂载的能力。

sents.en: Interface contracts support compatibility checks and component replacement; they do not establish behavioral isolation or safe admission.
sents.zh: 接口契约支持兼容性检查和组件替换，但并未建立行为隔离或安全准入机制。

sents.en: Adoption still requires validation of the composed behavior.
sents.zh: 采用时仍需对组合后的行为进行验证。

paragraphs.en: Using DSH Everything, a Codex plugin lets the agent generate tools during execution and retain them for later tasks ( shen2026dsheverything ; pan2026eip ) . In a simulated office workload, spreadsheets from different company regions vary in language and content but share similar calculations. Codex creates batch-lookup and summarization tools: first-task tool calls fall from 13 to 3, while wall time rises by 54.9% and tokens by 15.7%. A separately reported cumulative series shows savings from the second task, reaching 110,351 tokens and 22.97 s after five tasks (Table 3 ). The first-task totals imply increases of 6,453 tokens and 8.51 s, whereas cumulative row 1 reports 4,895 tokens and 6.74 s. This unresolved difference prevents treating the two reports as a single cost trajectory; negative cumulative differences indicate savings.
paragraphs.zh: 通过 DSH Everything（一个 Codex 插件），智能体可以在执行过程中生成工具，并在后续任务中保留这些工具（shen2026dsheverything；pan2026eip）。 在模拟的办公工作负载中，来自不同公司区域的电子表格在语言和内容上有所不同，但计算逻辑相似。 Codex 创建了批量查询和摘要工具：第一任务的工具调用次数从 13 次降至 3 次，而实际运行时间增加了 54.9%，令牌数增加了 15.7%。 一份单独报告的累计数据显示了第二任务带来的节省效果：完成五个任务后，累计节省了 110,351 个令牌和 22.97 秒（表 3）。 第一任务的总计数据表明，令牌数增加了 6,453 个，运行时间增加了 8.51 秒；而累计数据第一行则报告了 4,895 个令牌和 6.74 秒。 这种尚未解决差异使得无法将两份报告视为单一的成本轨迹；负值的累计差异表示节省了资源。
